rule: Every case_id occurs once in a feature Examples row or an individually tagged scenario; grouping does not merge requests.

oo.list_return: status or pattern-error text followed by the complete named-capture map

dm6.scalar_return: serialized local date-time or empty text; an invalid regular expression can raise

groups.scenario: Parse one accepted directive through both public routes
groups.outcome_type: OO status and typed date-time; DM6 typed date-time

groups.scenario: Keep the rejected Sunday-week composition visible
groups.outcome_type: OO failure status with no value read; DM6 empty text

groups.scenario: Return the complete reference named-capture record
groups.outcome_type: OO status, typed date-time, and full named-capture map; DM6 typed date-time

groups.scenario: Distinguish rejected patterns from a valid pattern that does not match
groups.outcome_type: OO error or no-match status with no value read; DM6 empty text

groups.scenario: An invalid regular expression raises before either route can return a status
groups.outcome_type: OO and DM6 exceptions with no returned value

groups.scenario: Preserve the observed DateFormat change after the percent-x pattern is used
groups.outcome_type: initial typed date-time followed by OO failure with no value read and DM6 empty text

groups.scenario: The POSIX rendering setting does not change percent-x pattern parsing
groups.outcome_type: OO status and typed date-time; DM6 typed date-time

groups.scenario: Preserve numeric-prefix acceptance for malformed epoch text
groups.outcome_type: OO status and typed date-time; DM6 typed date-time
